learning_outcomes.text: Students will know what needs to be done and the responsibilities in the field of public relations in business life.
Acquires the skill to analyze the causes of deficiencies and errors in practice.
The course encourages research and examinations in the field of public relations.
Ensures that the importance of Public Relations units in businesses is understood.

syllabus_topics: Definition of public relations, its importance and historical development
The place of public relations in the understanding of social responsibility, concepts close to public relations
Examination of the relationship between T.K.Y. and Organizational culture and public relations. Determination of effective communication techniques for these issues
Aims pursued in public relations, basic principles
The place and organization of the public relations unit within the general organization
Features that public relations should have in the workplace and among employees
Target audience in public relations policy in the enterprise (internal and external target audience), press relations
Communication tools used in public relations (written and verbal, visual and auditory tools)
Effective presentation technique in public relations (presentation plan, use of audio-visual materials)
The effect of effective speaking, effective listening and questioning technique in public relations presentations
Public relations in service enterprises and industrial enterprises
